definitions.amountEth: Current indexed bounty reward amount in ETH at snapshot time. Not a historical deposit flow, net payout, or withdrawal total.
definitions.bounties: Number of indexed bounty created events on each UTC day.
definitions.claims: Number of indexed claim created events (proof submissions) on each UTC day, including claims later rejected or hidden by the frontend.
definitions.claimsInBountyList: Lifetime indexed proof submissions for that bounty at snapshot time, rather than submissions only within the selected period.
definitions.completed: Number of indexed claim accepted events on each UTC day. Acceptance completes a bounty; it is not a count of withdrawals or successful payment transfers.
definitions.status: Current indexed state at snapshot time: canceled flag first, otherwise completed when an accepted event exists, otherwise open.
definitions.wallets: Distinct valid, nonzero event-associated wallet addresses across indexed protocol actions. Lowercase addresses are deduplicated across all selected chains and dates. An address is not a person and is not necessarily the transaction sender.

limitations: This is a bundled snapshot of the public offchain indexer, not a live or independently audited replay of contract logs. Indexer omissions and lag cannot be ruled out.

Contract scope is inferred from the official v3 frontend offsets (Ethereum 0, Arbitrum 180, Base 986) and each indexed id/onChainId relation; the REST API does not expose the emitting contract address.

The 365-day period includes days before these v3 contracts first appear in the indexer. Legacy v2 and Degen activity are intentionally excluded. Zero means no matching indexed events, not an assertion about unseen chain history.
Event-associated wallets include creators, claimants, contributors and other indexed actors or recipients. Invalid indexer sentinel addresses such as 0x00 are excluded. Addresses are not people.
Bounty status, listed reward values and per-bounty claim totals are current at snapshot time. Daily activity counts use event timestamps and exclude the unfinished current UTC day.
The refresh script does not independently replay contract logs. ETH flow and payout totals are omitted rather than inferred from mutable bounty amounts.
source.method: Every bounties and transactions page on chains 1, 42161 and 8453, 100 rows per page. Include bounty IDs with the official v3 frontend offset and validate every id/onChainId relation. Group their indexed events by UTC day. Verify one creation event and matching creation timestamp for every included bounty.
